item.title: Super Falcons step up preparation for WAFCON 2026 warm-up matches

item.title: Budget discipline: FG orders MDAs to follow spending framework ​
item.description: The Federal Government of Nigeria has directed all Ministries, Departments and Agencies, MDAs, to strictly comply with the Medium-Term Expenditure Framework, MTEF, as part of efforts to strengthen budget credibility and promote fiscal discipline across public institutions.
